name: 7367-sharedprefix-llama4scout-tp8
model: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct, bf16: a re-upload of meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct with the same weights; the Llama 4 Community License applies.
parallelism: tp8 over the eight GPUs of one node, one KV head per rank. No PP, no DP, no EP, no external cache tier.
architecture: Llama4ForConditionalGeneration MoE, 109B total with 17B active, bf16: 48 decoder layers of which 36 are chunked-local at attention_chunk_size 8192 and 12 are full attention, 40 query and 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, 16 experts with 1 active, vocab 202048. Text only; the checkpoint's vision tower is left off.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, bounded at 384 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup 25% and cooldown 10% leaving 250 measured requests.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn: 32,768 shared prefix tokens (prefix_count 1) plus 8,192 unique prompt tokens plus 256 output tokens per request, all stdev 0. temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true, so every request generates its full 256 tokens.
purpose: A long-context document analysis assistant on eight GPUs, 32 concurrent users sharing a 32k-token prefix per request.
launch:
# Eight GPUs of one node, all eight tensor-parallel, serving a 109B-total / 17B-active
# mixture-of-experts model in bf16 at a 100k-token context.

# A re-upload of meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct with the same weights; the Llama 4
# Community License applies. If it is ever republished, pin the revision:
# afd8e498c87bda51c7ea8ec68ea2f7c066e6340b.
model-path: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct

tp-size: 8

# One of the two inputs to how the KV pool is split, so changing it asks a different
# question. Far below what the checkpoint allows (max_position_embeddings 10485760).
context-length: 100000

# If the server does not start, step this to 0.75 before anything else is touched. Do not
# reach for context-length: it sizes the pools rather than relaxing a limit.
mem-fraction-static: 0.8

# Pinned: this architecture's local-attention path is implemented for fa3 and not for the
# other backends at this version.
attention-backend: fa3

# The 36 chunked-local layers and the 12 global ones get separately sized KV pools rather
# than being charged alike; this is the ratio that sizes them.
hybrid-kvcache-ratio: 0.95

max-running-requests: 32

# Follows max-running-requests. CUDA graphs stay ON; the derived default here would be 512,
# which captures rungs this workload cannot reach and costs minutes of startup.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 32
